question: Where is the nearest fast food restaurant found as you head from Faith Arena, Surprise, AZ toward Marriott's Canyon Villas, Phoenix, AZ?
sql: WITH start_loc AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Faith Arena%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Surprise%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%AZ%' LIMIT 1 ), end_loc AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Marriott''s Canyon Villas%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Phoenix%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%AZ%' LIMIT 1 ), path_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS line_geom FROM start_loc s, end_loc e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_loc s WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT line_geom FROM path_line)::geography, 1000) -- Search within 1000 meters of the direct path ORDER BY ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) LIMIT 1;
